Important: while the cameras are on

Do not close MapControl by swiping it away in the recent apps screen while the cameras or recording are on.

Closing the app suddenly while the cameras are on can disturb the screen or turn it black, and you may need to restart the head unit.

To stop recording, use the Stop button in the app or turn off automatic recording.
Updating MapControl closes the app, so the cameras and any running Camera 360 recording are stopped automatically before the update.\n\nContinue?
⚠️ While recording, do not close MapControl by swiping it away in recent apps, and stop recording before updating. Otherwise the screen may turn black and the head unit may need a restart.
Recording is split into 3-minute clips. When the USB fills up, the oldest clips are deleted; copy clips you want to keep elsewhere.
